non_blind_reason: the seed-42 reading 0.6080587938801277 and the whole W18 first-stage grid (including hp_d4_n200 = 0.5998203128630835) were known before this file was written; this is a within-family second-stage hyperparameter fine-tune, not an external test
question: on the frozen protocol (5 folds x 10 repeats, GroupKFold by InChIKey, Physical(lever4), train_mask full_base 2029 rows, score_mask scored 457 rows / 97 compounds), does the pre-registered second-stage arm push the cross-seed mean R2 to >= 0.60 with a five-seed lower bound (min of the five per-seed repeat means) > 0.55?
mechanism: P0 second stage: hold max_depth = 4 and n_estimators in 200-400 and probe min_child_weight / colsample_bytree / max_bin around the W18 winning arm; inner-fold tuning (GroupKFold inside every training fold) is reported as a side arm; the outer folds do not move; a placebo run permutes the scored targets before fitting

frozen_protocol.model_process: one process per seed; inside each seed a nested process pool over (repeat, fold) tasks

grid.selection_rule: seven fixed second-stage arms (7 x 5 seeds = 35 readings) plus the frozen reference arm plus one inner-fold arm; the arm names below are the registered set and the run refuses any other order
grid.side_information_rule: only the registered_arm decides the verdict; every other arm of the grid, including the inner-fold arm and the highest side arm, is side information and may not revise it
grid.cost_note: one fit of the dense Physical(lever4) design matrix costs about 0.6-1.0 s CPU (measured before the first fit; the frozen head is n_jobs = 1)

single_arm_discipline: single-arm pre-registration: the verdict is computed from REGISTERED_ARM alone; picking the maximum of the grid is nearly certain to clear 0.60 and is explicitly not a threshold pass

inner_fold_arm.role: side information; never decides the verdict

anchors.fold_signature: must equal dielectric_pool_expansion_benchmark.fold_signature of the frozen scoreboard splits
anchors.on_mismatch: refuse to report anything else and exit non-zero

decision_rule.five_seed_lower_bound_definition: the minimum over the five locked seeds of that seed's 10-repeat mean R2 (r2_seed_min)
decision_rule.promoted: the registered arm has cross-seed mean R2 >= 0.60 AND its five-seed lower bound > 0.55
decision_rule.placebo: verdict is placebo when --placebo is used; the scored-row target is permuted before fitting
decision_rule.secondary_only: the one-sided 95% t lower confidence bound of the cross-seed mean is reported but does not gate

placebo_rule.collapse: collapsed = (placebo cross-seed mean < 0.60) AND (placebo cross-seed mean < the real cross-seed mean of the same arm)

caliber_anchors.note: these five are the frozen caliber; they may not be mixed with each other

main_scoreboard_rule: only if the gate is met: attempts_this_week = 1 and attempts_cumulative = 12 (this repository's 12th main-scoreboard attempt); otherwise attempts_this_week = 0 and attempts_cumulative stays 11
promotion_rule: the frozen headline stays 0.4766400383507876 and the frozen baseline stays 0.4091179943351143; promotion is recorded on the main-scoreboard ledger but never rewrites them
